Thanks — pulling artifacts now. Quick notes from infra/security ops:
- In transit: TLS 1.2 (minimum) and TLS 1.3 supported for public endpoints. Cipher suites: ECDHE + AES-GCM / CHACHA20-POLY1305; we prefer TLS1.3 where available.
- At rest: Block and object storage use envelope encryption. Data plane uses AES-256-GCM; metadata records are also encrypted.
- KMS/HSM: Customer tenant keys are stored in a managed KMS with HSM-backed key material. For Redwood-hosted keys we use an HSM-backed service (vendor: YubiHSM cluster for private deployments; cloud KMS with HSM root for hosted). Keys for customer-only BYOK are customer-managed — Redwood never has plaintext.

I'm attaching the rotation change log (signed by key-ops) and a draft key-flow diagram. The rotation log includes timestamps and the rotated key IDs; there's also an emergency rotation playbook.

Attachment: Redwood_KMS_Rotation_Plan.pdf (signed rotation log)
Attachment: KV-Encryption-Architecture.png (diagram)

I'll add an excerpt of the HSM attestation but will need a quick redaction to remove serial numbers. Evelyn, can you confirm redaction rules for external sharing?

Mina

Jordan — thanks for the patience. We uploaded the evidence package to the SIG portal and shared drive (links below). Summary highlights:

- In transit: TLS1.2+ (prefer TLS1.3). Strong cipher suites (ECDHE + AES-GCM / ChaCha20). Certificate lifecycle: automated issuance via our CA pipeline; cert renewal is automated with monitoring and alerts.
- At rest: Envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM) for block/object and DB-level encryption for persistent stores. Keys are rotated on a 12-month schedule by default; production-sensitive keys rotate every 6 months per higher-sensitivity policy.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood uses HSM-backed key material for hosted master keys; customer BYOK remains customer-controlled. HSM attestations available on request (we redacted serials for security).
- Rotation evidence: attached rotation plan includes signed change log entries with timestamps, rotated key IDs (masked), and operator signatures. Emergency rotation playbook included.

SIG portal: https://sig-portal.brightsec.com/requests/ACME-9472
Shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/ACME/SIG/Encryption_Evidence

Attachments: sig_encryption_answers.xlsx, Redwood_KMS_Rotation_Plan.pdf, KV-Encryption-Architecture.png
